# Bernard Manning

Bernard Manning has participated in 5 elections since 2002:

- [**2011 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/bernard-manning#e15)

  Not elected.

  - [2011 Vote.je Manifesto](https://web.archive.org/web/20111017042643/http://www.vote.je:80/candidates/deputies/st-helier-district-2/bernie-manning/)
  - [2011 Full Manifesto](https://web.archive.org/web/20110928140515/http://www.channel103.com:80/election/?page_id=66)
- [**2014 St Helier No 2 Deputy By-Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/bernard-manning#e44)

  Not elected.
- [**2014 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/bernard-manning#e20)

  Not elected.

  - [2014 Vote.je Manifesto](https://web.archive.org/web/20230401132647/https://archive.vote.je/portfolio/manning-bernie/)
  - [2014 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ABfVhxnc43w)
- [**2018 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/bernard-manning#e42)

  Not elected.

  - [2018 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2018/bernie-manning-2/)
  - [2018 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=e_5FhqKezis)
  - [2018 Full Manifesto](http://www.berniemanning.co.uk/manifesto/)
  - [2018 Bailiwick Express Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pxUJX_TVw1s)
- [**2022 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/bernard-manning#e48)

  Not elected.

  - [2022 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2022/bernie-manning/)
  - [2022 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ieuyy0bsBrM)

Bernard Manning has declared his intention to stand in the upcoming [2026 Deputies Election](https://flow.je/elections/2026) in [District 6](https://flow.je/elections/district-6). \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/04/19/election-regular-makes-final-states-assembly-bid/)\]

Links for Bernard Manning:

- Website : [http://www.berniemanning.co.uk/](http://www.berniemanning.co.uk/)
- Twitter : [@ManningBernie](https://twitter.com/ManningBernie)

**Bernard Manning was not elected**.
